notes: Smoother charts and a more complete order list: the table now redraws only when your orders change, and no account is hidden when another one fills the table.
changelog: The chart redraws only when an order changes, instead of twice a second
Market-if-touched orders now show their trigger price
Orders from every account are scanned; a +N more row appears when the table is full
One shared order scan serves all your charts, lowering load with many charts open
Debug settings moved to the bottom of the Properties window
